description.en:
Walker C is UBTECH's full-size bipedal service humanoid for guided tours and interaction in exhibition halls and office environments. Its embodied-interaction model supports multilingual conversation, proactive greetings and answers based on a customized information database.

U-SLAM navigation and obstacle perception allow the robot to follow configured tour routes while adapting to nearby movement. Whole-body control combines walking with gestures and presentation behavior. UBTECH associates the platform with the China Pavilion at Expo 2025, illustrating its intended public-facing role. The content, route and service workflow are configured for each venue, rather than being identical across installations.
description.zh:
### 产品概述

Walker C是一款面向商业环境的全尺寸电驱具身智能人形机器人。依托优必选自研具身智能交互大模型，可在展厅、办公楼等场景提供多语种交互、智能导览和人机互动体验。
